column1: # Every contact in a 53 s raw capture of the G16's touchpad (report 4, 9364 reports): typing
# with palms resting, single fingertips, a deliberately flattened finger, clicks and two
# two-finger scrolls. One line per contact, in touch-down order: seconds from the first report,
# start position in mm from the left and top edges, reports it was down for, reports with
# Confidence clear (the pad's palm flag), peak signal strength (bits 0-7 of its vendor
# 0xFF01:0x02+slot value) and what it was: fingertip, flattened (the deliberately flattened
# finger), palm, or palm-brief (an unflagged palm brush of a few reports whose strength stays
# within the fingertips' range; left to libinput's disable-while-typing).
